history.summary: A 570 sqft freehold 1BR in D14/D15-fringe at $1456 PSF / $830k, but 1.05km (13-min walk) from Kembangan MRT and backed by only 2 URA transactions with no median PSF. Modest PSF and freehold tenure, but no reliable data to underwrite.
history.rating_rationale: $1456 PSF is on the lower end for a freehold 1BR and the sub-$840k quantum is accessible, but only 2 URA txns and no median mean there is no project-specific evidence of value or growth. The 1.05km/13-min walk to MRT weakens both rental and resale. Boutique freehold with a thin data trail — defaults to Neutral pending verification; not enough to confirm a Buy or condemn to Avoid.
